verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.pt: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses and to Aaron,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.
verses.pt: Falai aos filhos de Israel, e dizei-lhes: Qualquer homem, quando seu corrimento sair de sua carne, será impuro.
verses.en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.
verses.en_bbe: Say to the children of Israel: If a man has an unclean flow from his flesh, it will make him unclean.

verses.en: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.
verses.pt: E esta será sua impureza em seu fluxo; seja que sua carne derramou por causa de seu fluxo, ou que sua carne se obstruiu por causa de seu fluxo, ele será impuro.
verses.en_web: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.
verses.en_bbe: If the flow goes on or if the part is stopped up, to keep back the flow, he is still unclean.

verses.en: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.
verses.pt: Toda cama em que se deitar o que tiver fluxo, será impura; e toda coisa sobre que se sentar, impura será.
verses.en_web: “‘Every bed whereon he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.
verses.en_bbe: Every bed on which he has been resting will be unclean, and everything on which he has been seated will be unclean.

verses.en: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.pt: E qualquer um que tocar em sua cama, lavará suas roupas; lavará também a si mesmo com água, e será impuro até à tarde.
verses.en_web: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: And anyone touching his bed is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

verses.en: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.pt: E o que se sentar sobre aquilo em que se houver sentado o que tem fluxo, lavará suas roupas, se lavará também a si mesmo com água, e será impuro até à tarde.
verses.en_web: He who sits on anything whereon the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: And he who has been seated on anything on which the unclean man has been seated is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

verses.en: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.pt: Também o que tocar a carne do que tem fluxo, lavará suas roupas, e a si mesmo se lavará com água, e será impuro até à tarde.
verses.en_web: “‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: And anyone touching the flesh of the unclean man is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

verses.en: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.pt: E se o que tem fluxo cuspir sobre o limpo, este lavará suas roupas, e depois de haver-se lavado com água, será impuro até à tarde.
verses.en_web: “‘If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: And if liquid from the mouth of the unclean man comes on to him who is clean, then he is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

verses.en: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.
verses.pt: E toda sela sobre que cavalgar o que tiver fluxo, será impura.
verses.en_web: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.
verses.en_bbe: And any leather seat on a horse on which the unclean man has been seated will be unclean.

verses.en: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.pt: E qualquer um que tocar qualquer coisa que tenha estado debaixo dele, será impuro até à tarde; e o que a levar, lavará suas roupas, e depois de lavar-se com água, será impuro até à tarde.
verses.en_web: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. He who carries those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: And anyone touching anything which was under him will be unclean till the evening; anyone taking up any of these things is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

verses.en: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.pt: E todo aquele a quem tocar o que tem fluxo, e não lavar com água suas mãos, lavará suas roupas, e a si mesmo se lavará com água, e será impuro até à tarde.
verses.en_web: “‘Whoever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: And anyone on whom the unclean man puts his hands, without washing them in water, is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

verses.en: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
verses.pt: E a vasilha de barro em que tocar o que tem fluxo, será quebrada; e toda vasilha de madeira será lavada com água.
verses.en_web: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
verses.en_bbe: And any vessel of earth which has been touched by the unclean man will have to be broken and any vessel of wood washed.

verses.en: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
verses.pt: E quando se houver limpado de seu fluxo o que tem fluxo, se há de contar sete dias desde sua purificação, e lavará suas roupas, e lavará sua carne em águas vivas, e será limpo.
verses.en_web: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
verses.en_bbe: And when a man who has a flow from his body is made clean from it, he is to take seven days to make himself clean, washing his clothing and bathing his body in flowing water, and then he will be clean.

verses.en: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:
verses.pt: E no oitavo dia tomará duas rolinhas, ou dois pombinhos, e virá diante do SENHOR à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, e os dará ao sacerdote:
verses.en_web: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before Yahweh to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest:
verses.en_bbe: And on the eighth day he is to take two doves or two young pigeons and come before the Lord to the door of the Tent of meeting and give them to the priest:

verses.en: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.
verses.pt: E os fará o sacerdote, uma oferta pelo pecado, e o outro holocausto: e lhe purificará o sacerdote de seu fluxo diante do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: and the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh for his discharge.
verses.en_bbe: And they are to be offered by the priest, one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering, and the priest will take away his sin before the Lord on account of his flow.

verses.en: And if any man’s seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.pt: E o homem, quando dele sair derramamento seminal, lavará em águas toda sua carne, e será impuro até à tarde.
verses.en_web: “‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: And if a man's seed goes out from him, then all his body will have to be bathed in water and he will be unclean till evening.

verses.en: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.pt: E toda vestimenta, ou toda pele sobre a qual houver o derramamento seminal, lavará com água, e será impura até à tarde.
verses.en_web: Every garment, and every skin, whereon the semen is, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: And any clothing or skin on which the seed comes is to be washed with water and be unclean till evening.

verses.en: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.pt: E a mulher com quem o homem tiver ajuntamento seminal, ambos se lavarão com água, e serão impuros até à tarde.
verses.en_web: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: And if a man has sex relations with a woman and his seed goes out from him, the two of them will have to be bathed in water and will be unclean till evening.

verses.en: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
verses.pt: E quando a mulher tiver fluxo de sangue, e seu fluxo for em sua carne, sete dias estará separada; e qualquer um que tocar nela, será impuro até à tarde.
verses.en_web: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days: and whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: And if a woman has a flow of blood from her body, she will have to be kept separate for seven days, and anyone touching her will be unclean till evening.

verses.en: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
verses.pt: E tudo aquilo sobre que ela se deitar durante sua separação, será impuro: também tudo aquilo sobre que se sentar, será impuro.
verses.en_web: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.
verses.en_bbe: And everything on which she has been resting, while she is kept separate, will be unclean, and everything on which she has been seated will be unclean.

verses.en: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.pt: E qualquer um que tocar a sua cama, lavará suas roupas, e depois de lavar-se com água, será impuro até à tarde.
verses.en_web: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: And anyone touching her bed will have to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

verses.en: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.pt: Também qualquer um que tocar qualquer móvel sobre que ela se houver sentado, lavará suas roupas; lavará logo a si mesmo com água, e será impuro até à tarde.
verses.en_web: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: And anyone touching anything on which she has been seated will have to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

verses.en: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
verses.pt: E se estiver sobre a cama, ou sobre a cadeira em que ela se houver sentado, o que tocar nela será impuro até à tarde.
verses.en_web: If it is on the bed, or on anything whereon she sits, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: Anyone touching anything on the bed or on the thing on which she has been seated, will be unclean till evening.

verses.en: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
verses.pt: E se alguém dormir com ela, e sua menstruação for sobre ele, será impuro por sete dias; e toda cama sobre que dormir, será impura.
verses.en_web: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed whereon he lies shall be unclean.
verses.en_bbe: And if any man has sex relations with her so that her blood comes on him, he will be unclean for seven days and every bed on which he has been resting will be unclean.

verses.en: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.
verses.pt: E a mulher, quando seguir o fluxo de seu sangue por muitos dias fora do tempo de seu costume, ou quando tiver fluxo de sangue mais de seu costume; todo o tempo do fluxo de seu imundícia, será impura como nos dias de seu costume.
verses.en_web: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period; all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period: she is unclean.
verses.en_bbe: And if a woman has a flow of blood for a long time, not at the time when she generally has it, or if the flow goes on longer than the normal time, she will be unclean while the flow of blood goes on, as she is at other normal times.

verses.en: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.
verses.pt: Toda cama em que dormir todo o tempo de seu fluxo, lhe será como a cama de seu costume; e todo móvel sobre que se sentar, será impuro, como a impureza de seu costume.
verses.en_web: Every bed whereon she lies all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period: and everything whereon she sits shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her period.
verses.en_bbe: Every bed on which she has been resting will be unclean, as at the times when she normally has a flow of blood, and everything on which she has been seated will be unclean, in the same way.

verses.en: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.pt: Qualquer um que tocar em essas coisas será impuro; e lavará suas roupas, e a si mesmo se lavará com água, e será impuro até à tarde.
verses.en_web: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: And anyone touching these things will be unclean, and his clothing will have to be washed and his body bathed in water and he will be unclean till evening.

verses.en: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
verses.pt: E quando for livre de seu fluxo, se há de contar sete dias, e depois será limpa.
verses.en_web: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
verses.en_bbe: But when her flow of blood is stopped, after seven days she will be clean.

verses.en: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.pt: E o oitavo dia tomará consigo duas rolinhas, ou dois pombinhos, e os trará ao sacerdote, à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho:
verses.en_web: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.en_bbe: And on the eighth day let her get two doves or two young pigeons and take them to the priest to the door of the Tent of meeting,

verses.en: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.
verses.pt: E o sacerdote fará um oferta pelo pecado, e o outro holocausto; e a purificará o sacerdote diante do SENHOR do fluxo de sua impureza.
verses.en_web: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Yahweh for the uncleanness of her discharge.
verses.en_bbe: To be offered by the priest, one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering; and the priest will take away her sin before the Lord on account of her unclean condition.

verses.en: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.
verses.pt: Assim separareis os filhos de Israel de suas imundícias, a fim de que não morram por suas imundícias, contaminando meu tabernáculo que está entre eles.
verses.en_web: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’”
verses.en_bbe: In this way may the children of Israel be made free from all sorts of unclean conditions, so that death may not overtake them when they are unclean and when they make unclean my holy place which is among them.

verses.en: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;
verses.pt: Esta é a lei do que tem fluxo, e do que sai derramamento seminal, vindo a ser impuro por causa disso;
verses.en_web: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean thereby;
verses.en_bbe: This is the law for the man who has a flow from his body, or whose seed goes from him so that he is unclean;

verses.en: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
verses.pt: E da que padece seu costume, e acerca do que tiver fluxo, seja homem ou fêmea, e do homem que dormir com mulher impura.
verses.en_web: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.
verses.en_bbe: And for her who has a flow of blood, and for any man or woman who has an unclean flow, and for him who has sex relations with a woman when she is unclean.
